content: I'm building a small side-project app (a Next.js booking tool, maybe 200 users to start). What are good managed Postgres hosting options and what do they cost?

For a small app with around 200 users, four managed Postgres hosts are worth a look:

| Provider | Entry paid plan | Free tier | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Neon | Launch, $19/month | Yes, 0.5 GB storage | Serverless, scales to zero, database branching |
| Supabase | Pro, $25/month | Yes, 500 MB database, pauses after a week idle | Postgres plus auth, storage and realtime |
| Railway | Hobby, $5/month plus usage | No, trial credit only | Simple deploys, app and database in one place |
| Render | Basic Postgres from $6/month | Yes, expires after 30 days | Predictable fixed pricing |

**My pick for you:** start on Neon's free tier. Scale-to-zero suits a booking tool with bursty traffic, and the $19 Launch plan is the natural next step. Choose Supabase instead if you also want auth and file storage from the same vendor.

As of Tuesday, 3 November 2026.
Give me three subject lines for a cold outreach email to heads of sales at logistics companies.

Three options, each under 45 characters so they survive mobile previews:

1. "Cutting quote turnaround at {{company}}"
2. "A question about your dispatch-to-sales handoff"
3. "How 3PL sales teams are shortening deal cycles"

The first usually wins on open rate because it names a concrete outcome and the recipient's company.
We shortlisted 5 CRM tools for our 20-person sales team: HubSpot, Pipedrive, Zoho CRM, Freshsales and Close. Can you compare them on pricing per seat?

Here is the shortlist on entry-level paid pricing, billed annually, and what it means for 20 seats:

| Tool | Plan | Price per seat / month | 20 seats / month | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| HubSpot | Sales Hub Starter | $20 | $400 | Free CRM underneath; Professional jumps to $100 per seat |
| Pipedrive | Lite | $14 | $280 | Pipeline-first; automations start on the Growth plan |
| Zoho CRM | Standard | $14 | $280 | Cheapest route to custom modules; Professional is $23 |
| Freshsales | Growth | $9 | $180 | Built-in phone and email; Pro is $39 |
| Close | Essentials | $35 | $700 | Built for calling-heavy teams; power dialer on Growth at $99 |

**For a 20-person team:** Freshsales is the cheapest at about $180/month, Pipedrive and Zoho tie at $280, and Close costs the most but includes calling that the others charge extra for. If your reps live on the phone, Close can still come out ahead once you add a dialer to the others.

As of Monday, 9 November 2026.
